- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the
CHANGELOG.md: PRs add lines under `## Unreleased`. Let me check the current Unreleased section format.

on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

blocks.text:
- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4

  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on

  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. ### Fix

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

- fix(#1705): CLI fresh-install boarding asks the provider choice FIRST —
  the same list the `/add-provider` picker shows (presets, `Custom` last) —
  and only `Custom` continues into the api-type wizard; a preset opens its
  own flow with the api type prefilled. Previously boarding opened the
  custom wizard directly, cold-asking "api type" before any provider was
  chosen.
- feat(providers): gh-1704 — first-class Codex/ChatGPT credential export,
  CI refresh action, and Provider Queue integration (Copilot-export
  parity). `fa provider export <name> [--check]` resolves the saved
  ChatGPT login's OAuth blob from its secure-store slot, refreshes it when
  stale, and prints the shell lines (`OPENAI_API_KEY` + `OPENAI_BASE_URL`
  = the Codex backend — these tokens never serve api.openai.com); the
  refresh token never prints and `--check` reports credential health with

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

blocks.text:
- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the

# Changelog

Older entries: [CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md](CHANGELOG_ARCHIVE.md) — moved out
on 2026-10-09 (gh-1452): pub.dev server-rejects a publish whose
CHANGELOG.md exceeds its 262144-byte content cap, so this file keeps a
bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

## Unreleased

- fix(test): gh-1732 — the `wrap_ansi_line_perf_test` sustained-contention
  validation leg spikes 3 of the 5 doubled runs per attempt instead of 4
  (CI run 39546301132, core shard 2/4: the old shape left exactly ONE
  real-wall-clock-timed doubled sample per attempt, and real jitter on
  that single sample — the very shape being modeled — inflated all three
  attempts' min ratios to a 3.30x best against the 3.2 bound while the
  real 500k growth legs on the same runner stayed green). 3-of-5 is the
  documented live-red shape ("≥3 of the 5 timed runs"): median-of-5
  [c,c,s] is still a spiked value, so the leg still proves the
  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

  chosen.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

blocks.text:
- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release
  (`scripts/auto_release.sh` via `ci.yml`) — ZERO commits land on main
  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First
  publish of a NEW package is manual — pub.dev OIDC only uploads new
  versions of an existing package (issue #1511): owner runs
  `cd packages/fa_llm && dart pub publish` once, adds the OIDC publisher
  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow
  pre-flights the package-exists probe and exits 10 with the
  instructions on 404; see `packages/fa_llm/README.md` §Publishing.
- CLI binaries build per tag (`ci.yml` `binaries` job), attach to the

approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.

- Every push to `main` cuts an annotated TAG + GitHub Release

  (gh-1522: the retired flow pushed a 4-file `chore(release):` bot commit
  per release). The git TAG is the single source of truth for versions:
  both pubspecs carry the FIXED `0.0.0-dev` placeholder (a hand-bump fails
  the Static `Version placeholder guard`), `pubspec.lock` never churns, and
  CI stamps the version at the edges: the `publish` job stamps the STAGED
  publish tree (pubspec version + generated changelog section prepend via
  `scripts/stamp_staged_release.sh`, staged version == tag guarded
  pre-upload), store/mobile builds stamp `--build-name/--build-number` from
  the derived tag version, `install_local.sh` stamps `version.txt` from
  `git describe`. CHANGELOG.md is curated-only: PRs add lines under
  `## Unreleased`; the release folds it into the tag's section AT STAGE
  TIME (`scripts/release_notes.sh` preference order: curated `## <version>`
  section → curated `## Unreleased` body → conventional commits since the
  previous tag). The version scheme is `1.0.<counter>` (gh-785: App Store
  Connect approved 1.0.0 and enforces a monotonic
  `CFBundleShortVersionString`, so the pre-promotion `0.1.<counter>`
  train can never upload again). Release checklist: push to main (or the
  `releaseDispatch` dispatch) → watch the ci.yml `release` job cut the tag
  → watch the tag-scoped `publish` + `binaries` jobs. `fa --version` reads
  the stamped `version.txt` first, the placeholder pubspec second.
- `packages/fa_llm` publishes per `fa_llm-v*` tag via
  `.github/workflows/publish-fa-llm.yml` (OIDC, no secrets). First

  entry on pub.dev, then the workflow takes over. The workflow

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

# Changelog

bounded recent window and `scripts/check_changelog_size.sh` fails fast when the cap is
approached. Since gh-1522 this file is CURATED-ONLY: add new lines under
`## Unreleased` and the release folds them into the tag's section at
publish-staging time — the published artifact's changelog is generated
(and trimmed under the cap by `stamp_staged_release.sh`), and the
publish job only WARNS on this repo file, so this file's size can never
block a release again.

  pre-gh-1532 median harness fails, and the min harness now rides two
  clean doubled samples per attempt.

  chosen.

SESSIONS AND COMPACTION
  Every run (REPL or headless) appends to a JSONL session under the session
  root (--session-root, default ~/.fah/sessions; macOS: ~/Library/Group
  Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions), laid out per working
  directory. Start with --session <name> or use /session, /session-new,

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

SESSIONS AND COMPACTION
  Every run (REPL or headless) appends to a JSONL session under the session
  root (--session-root, default ~/.fah/sessions; macOS: ~/Library/Group
  Containers/group.dev.fa1.shared/fa/sessions), laid out per working
  directory. Start with --session <name> or use /session, /session-new,

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

{"content":"### Root Cause
When auto-compaction fired, `formatCompactionReport` (`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`) unconditionally rendered the full detail block — the `records:` line plus the entire internal checkpoint summary in a fenced block — and the CLI hooks wrote it to the console on every fold. The headless log face additionally streamed every summarizer delta (the whole summary text) live. No config key gated any of it (`tui:` only knew `theme`/`classic`/`statusLine`).

### Fix
- `formatCompactionReport` gained `details` (default `false`): the default report is ONE marker line — `● auto-compacted · engine: N → M tokens (F freed · P%)`.
- New config key `tui.showCompactionDetails` (default `false`; strict-parsed, `fa config set`-writable, persisted only when true): `true` restores the full block and the headless live delta stream. The manual `/compact` always renders the full block (it IS the on-demand expansion).
- Liveness with details hidden is unchanged: the gh-1430 `… reasoning Ns` line already covers the compaction window on line-mode/headless faces.
- Nothing is lost by default — the summary stays in the session file, reachable via `compact_expand`.
- Files: `agent_cli_compaction.dart`, `tui_status_line.dart`, `cli_config.dart`, `agent_cli_config.dart`, `config_service.dart`, `bin/fah_runapp.dart`, `cli_help.dart`, `prompts/skills/self-settings/SKILL.md`.

### Test Coverage
- `test/cli/compaction_report_test.dart`: new `gh-1636 one-line default` group (marker line, no checkpoint text; `details: true` keeps the full block).
- `test/cli/workflow_log_fidelity_test.dart`: default headless log face is summary-free (no delta echo, one marker line, continuation intact); the gh-1433 E4 dim thinking stream is pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/structured_compaction_observability_test.dart`: one receipt per fold on default; counters-match-session pinned under the opt-in.
- `test/cli/tui_status_line_test.dart` + `test/config/config_service_test.dart`: key parse/round-trip/strict-validation + `fa config set` end-to-end.
- Full suite (`test/cli`, `test/compaction`, `test/config`): all green.

### Notes
- Deliberate behavior change: the gh-1433 E4 "no silent windows" headless delta stream and the issue #438 stderr counter lines are now opt-in (`tui.showCompactionDetails: true`); the receipt-per-fold contract (one `● auto-compacted` line per fold, honest token numbers) is unchanged.
- Related-but-different issues untouched: #653 (stale badge), #286, #1425.

The `error: RangeError...` comes from `_handleRunError` via `_keyStatusView.errorLine`. So the RangeError is thrown as a RUN error during the continuation prompt (`_runPrompt` → run → error). Where could a RangeError arise from my change INSIDE the run?

Hmm wait — maybe the RangeError is NOT from my code at all — maybe my change altered the SEQUENCE of scripted turn consumption! The FakeStreamFunction hands out turns in order:
1. toolTurn (3 calls)
2. textTurn('S') — consumed by mid-run relief compaction attempt
3. textTurn('S') — consumed as post-run compaction summary
4. textTurn('continued after compaction') — the continuation answer

In base, the first compaction attempt might have been a NO-OP pass (the "no-op pass — stay quiet" branch: `pass.tokensAfter == pass.tokensBefore && pass.hiddenRecords == 0 && pass.sumarizedMessages == 0` → no report).
